newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Leighton wins A$122 mln HK housing contract.
newsitem.headline: Leighton wins A$122 mln HK housing contract.

text.p: Leighton Contractors (Asia) Ltd, a division of Leighton Asia Ltd, said on Friday it has been awarded a HK$697 million (A$122 million) contract to construct a major housing development at Fanling in Hong Kong's New Territories for the Hong Kong Housing Authority.
Leighton Asia is a division of Australia's largest construction group, Leighton Holdings Ltd, and has been operating in Hong Kong since 1975.
Leighton said the contract involves the construction of four, 41-storey residential towers containing a total of 1,280 units, an estate management office and tradesman's quarters.
Construction is due to commence immediately and is scheduled for completion in September 1999.
Leighton Asia managing director John Faulkner said the contract continues the company's long-standing relationship with the Hong Kong Housing Authority.
Faulkner said prospects for the company remained positive.

"The current outlook for us here in Hong Kong and indeed throughout the region, is excellent. Our work in hand portfolio contains a comfortable balance of building and civil work for both the public and private sector," he said in a statement.
